classes_checked.what_was_checked: Compared declared-absent rows, reason-code and unextracted-outcome audits, and age metadata with held abstracts, both held trial full texts, and regulatory quotations embedded in review.json.
Compared eight primary HRs and confidence intervals with their held abstract clauses; checked the REWIND gastrointestinal and LEADER discontinuation count-based RR inputs.
Checked primary composite definitions, ELIXA four-point versus three-point handling, harm count rows, and EXSCEL serious-only discontinuation refusal.
Compared screening decisions for the 11 held PubMed records with their population descriptions, including SELECT's exclusion.

Inspected primary-report assignments and SOUL's held abstract and family records. The supplied lane fact establishes abridgement, but the original abstract was not located in this extract for a local quotation pair.
Compared the held Giugliano comparator's estimate, interval, trial enumeration and methods with served comparator records; checked explicit recency and ELIXA endpoint qualifications.
Compared trial keys, labels and outcomes across the 17 reason-code audit rows and 27 unextracted-outcome audit rows.
Inspected per-trial endpoint definitions, follow-up fields and registry identities; reproduced the REWIND harm endpoint derivation using harness.compat_check.

findings.title: ELIXA absence audit contradicts the embedded regulatory extraction

claim.quote: value absent from every held source inspected; code is consistent

evidence.quote: ITT analyses (on-study and on-treatment) of MACE, defined as cardiovascular death, non-fatal MI, and non-fatal stroke, are consistent with those of MACE+ (Table 8). The reason for the similarity is that only 0.3% of subjects in the ITT population experienced hospitalization for unstable angina. For ITT analysis 792 MACE events were observed, 392 and 400 in placebo and lixisenatide group, respectively. The 95% confidence interval for the hazard ratio is (0.887, 1.172) with a point estimate of 1.02.

findings.why_wrong: The ELIXA primary-outcome audit assigns REASON_TRUE to OUTCOME_NOT_IN_SOURCE, while held_regulatory_facts in the same served file preserves an explicitly three-component MACE extraction. This establishes an internal contradiction; the original regulatory PDF is outside this extract, so its transcription was not independently verified.
findings.served_effect: ELIXA remains outside the primary pool and is classified NOT_IN_HELD_SOURCES despite an embedded extracted result. The page's stale-result warning acknowledges missing incorporation but does not correct the absence audit.
findings.proposed_fixture: Use the existing ELIXA declared-absent row and its held_regulatory_facts entry as input. Assert that a matching three-point MACE HR and interval prevent REASON_TRUE/NOT_IN_HELD_SOURCES; classify the result as held pending adjudication or extraction instead.

findings.title: REWIND gastrointestinal result inherits the cardiovascular endpoint definition

claim.quote: "endpoint_definition": "primary outcome was the first occurrence of the composite endpoint of non-fatal myocardial infarction, non-fatal stroke, or death from cardiovascular causes (including unknown causes), which was assessed in the intention-to-treat population"

evidence.quote: 2347 (47·4%) participants assigned to dulaglutide reported a gastrointestinal adverse event during follow-up compared with 1687 (34·1%) participants assigned to placebo (p<0·0001).

findings.why_wrong: This endpoint_definition belongs to the gastrointestinal harm row for PMID 31189511. Its counts describe gastrointestinal adverse events, but _derive_endpoint selects the abstract's primary cardiovascular outcome definition without binding it to the requested outcome. Read-only execution reproduced the incorrect definition.
findings.served_effect: The harm row and its compatibility metadata describe MACE while its numerical input represents gastrointestinal adverse events.
findings.proposed_fixture: Pass the held REWIND abstract, its gastrointestinal count row and outcome name 'Gastrointestinal adverse events' to _derive_endpoint. Assert that the returned definition identifies gastrointestinal adverse events and does not contain the cardiovascular composite definition.

findings.title: Explicit adult ages are reported as not stated

evidence.quote: Men and women aged at least 50 years with type 2 diabetes who had either a previous cardiovascular event or cardiovascular risk factors were randomly assigned (1:1) to either weekly subcutaneous injection of dulaglutide (1·5 mg) or placebo.
The mean age of the patients was 66 years; 2695 patients (84.7%) were 50 years of age or older and had cardiovascular or chronic kidney disease.

findings.why_wrong: The quoted metadata occurs on REWIND and PIONEER 6 rows despite explicit adult ages in their held abstracts. The age classifier recognizes only narrow phrasings. Read-only calls also reproduced not_stated for HARMONY and SOUL.
findings.served_effect: Served review metadata falsely marks known adult populations as unspecified, weakening the population compatibility record.
findings.proposed_fixture: Feed the held REWIND abstract to _derive_population_age with an empty trial dictionary. Assert value == 'adult' and a nonempty supporting age span. Repeat with the held PIONEER 6, HARMONY and SOUL abstracts.
